summary: Defines S/MIME version 4.0, a consistent way to send and receive secure MIME data. Digital signatures give authentication, integrity, and proof of origin, encryption gives confidentiality, and compression can reduce size. It obsoletes RFC 5751 and is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: A way to put a signed, sealed envelope around an email so you know who sent it and nobody else can read it.

questions: how to sign and encrypt email
